what: gl/vortex step cost, #1812 edge-darkening build vs the #1811 build, identical scripted sessions (A/B)
method: The #1811 cost session (docs/review/1811/probe-cost.json): createVortex seed 970 at 1000x700, 240 warm-up frames of 4 scripted marks/frame with tint on every mark, wetAdvect 0.6, then 5 batches x 60 steps timed with performance.now. Pigment ends across ~56% of cells in both builds. Base = origin/main vortex.mjs in a shadow copy of the same tree; new = this build. Sandbox node on a shared VM; CI/device numbers remain the #1695 harness's to confirm.
verdict: The edge stage (one wetness snapshot copy per pigment-live step + the gradient accrual over the pigment box) adds ~+0.3 ms/step at the medians (3.71-3.87 base vs 3.85-4.32 new) - inside the registered 6.6 ms figure, which was itself measured on a busier VM (medians 6.93 / 6.28). Registration UNCHANGED: timeMs stays 6.6 (the standing worst-case measurement; re-registering downward on a quieter machine would understate the governor's worst case). memoryBytes grows by the two new planes: 128*128*4*9 + 128*128*16*3 + 4096*16*2 = 1507328.
